feature: opt-in ordinary Channel client Health Watch gate
head: 9adba618

design.watch_transport: dedicated connection owned by channel/health_gate.zig; never competes with the application RPC reader
design.first_status: the first gated call waits for a known status, bounded by the call deadline or five seconds when unbounded
design.not_serving: NOT_SERVING, UNKNOWN, and SERVICE_UNKNOWN reject fail-fast calls with ConnectionUnavailable
design.wait_for_ready: waits until serving or the call deadline
design.watch_failure: a Watch transport retry returns to unknown and fails open so a transient Watch failure does not block the application connection
design.shared_channel_boundary: SharedChannel keeps its same-connection health owner; this gate is a server-level compatibility path for ordinary Channel

verification.integration_test: real loopback health registry and unary responder: SERVING allows a call, NOT_SERVING returns ConnectionUnavailable, restored SERVING completes another call on the reused connection

limitations: the dedicated Watch is server-level, not same-subconnection health
unknown and retrying Watch states fail open
the first gated call pays one health-status roundtrip
